similarityReview: The model successfully captures the two massive, towering trunks of the Cryptomeria trees. The trunk geometry uses conical frustums to simulate the natural taper. The canopy is represented by multiple layered frustum_pyramids and ellipsoid_spheres to mimic the dense, needle-like foliage of giant conifers. The scale is set to reflect the immense height of these trees relative to the human figures present.
